people.name: Elizabeth
people.line: The wife of Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Priest, father of John the Baptist

translations.web: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
translations.bsb: But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.
translations.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
translations.asv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: because thy supplication is heard, and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
